newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian OTC market cuts settlement to T+5 days.
newsitem.headline: Croatian OTC market cuts settlement to T+5 days.

text.p: The Croatian over-the-counter (OTC) Varazdin market said on Tuesday it had shortened settlement to five from seven days from each transaction to improve quality.
"This is an important change in trading... to satisfy strict demands by brokerages and their clients," the Varazdin Securities Market said in a press release.
The move is also in line with preparations for the forming of a central depository for securities, it said.
The Varazdin market is working with Croatian computer engineers on developing an on-line trading system.
